'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024–2025 French political crisis]]
**[[Lecornu government]]
***[[France|French]] [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] [[Sébastien Lecornu]] announces his first batch of [[Government of France|minister]] appointments, including former [[Ministry of Economics and Finance (France)|finance minister]] [[Bruno Le Maire]] as [[Ministry of Armed Forces (France)|armed forces minister]], while facing a potential [[Motion of no confidence|no-confidence vote]] in [[French Parliament|parliament]]. *[[2025 Indonesian protests]]
**[[Indonesia]] lifts its temporary suspension of [[TikTok]]'s operating license after the platform provided [[Red and White Cabinet|government]]-requested data on [[live streaming]] activity during the recent protests. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2025/10/06/business/foreign-business/indonesia-lifts-tiktok-licence-suspension-as-app-shares-data/2195041 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[2025 Syrian parliamentary election]]
**[[Syrians]] vote to elect 121 of the 210 members of the [[People's Assembly of Syria|People's Assembly]] in the first election held since the [[fall of the Assad regime]] in [[2024 Syrian opposition offensives|December 2024]]. Elections are postponed in the [[Al-Hasakah Governorate|Al-Hasakah]], [[Raqqa Governorate|Raqqa]], and [[Suwayda Governorate|Suwayda]] [[Governorates of Syria|governorates]] due to security reasons. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/10/04/middleeast/syria-elections-first-post-assad-intl-hnk (CNN)]
